title: fix(objectql,driver-sql): a boolean field given 'true' / 'false' stores the boolean, and a stored text 'false' reads as false
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg2evNa1V3zxrQq3KX

Fixes #34916

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：布尔字段收到 `'true'` / `'false'`（以及 `'1'` / `'0'` / `1` / `0`）这类字符串写法时，引擎写入前统一转成真正的布尔值；SQL 驱动读到库里已存成文本的 `'false'` 时按 false 返回，不再读成 true。
- 为什么改：控制台行内表格把布尔列画成选项值为 `'true'` / `'false'` 的下拉框，保存时发出的是字符串。SQLite 原样存成文本，于是 `won = true` 过滤查不到这一行，`requiredWhen: record.won == true` 放过了空的交期；取消勾选存成 `'false'`，读出来却是 true。
- 风险与回滚：校验器原本就接受这几种写法，可接受的写入集合不变（`'yes'` 等仍被拒），变的只是存储形态。回滚即撤销本 PR。已存成文本的旧行：读取立即正确，但等值过滤要等该行再次保存后才命中。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`（`normalizeNumericStringRow` 新增的布尔分支与 `BOOLEAN_READINGS`）、`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-sqlite-serialisation.ts`（`presentStoredBoolean`）、`packages/rest/src/rest-data-boolean-reading.test.ts`（各写入入口的钉子）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run --project local src/rest-data-boolean-reading.test.ts`（需先构建 objectql 与 driver-sql），预期 6 个测试全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Engine write normalisation (`@objectstack/objectql`).** `normalizeNumericStringValues` runs on insert, update and validate, the one door that every REST, batch and import write reaches. It gains a boolean arm. On a `boolean` / `toggle` field it writes the boolean the validator's boolean arm judged: `'true'`, `'1'` and `1` become `true`, and `'false'`, `'0'` and `0` become `false` (`BOOLEAN_READINGS`, compared by SameValueZero). Every other value is left as sent, so the arm still refuses it with `invalid_boolean`. Its docblock gains the #34916 section, next to the #29241 and #29562 halves it follows.
- **Row read (`@objectstack/driver-sql`).** `formatOutput` presented every stored boolean as `Boolean(value)`. It now calls `presentStoredBoolean`: the text `'false'` / `'0'` reads as `false`, `'true'` / `'1'` as `true`, and every other value keeps its `Boolean(value)` reading. Real integers, booleans and NULL read exactly as before.
- **Changeset.** Patch for `@objectstack/objectql` and `@objectstack/driver-sql`, with both declaration lines.

## Why

Measured on origin/main `c81f498b5f` (report 6957257121; the seat's Premise corrected 6957305509). The console's inline grid maps a boolean field to a select column whose option values are the strings `'true'` / `'false'` (`deriveMasterDetail.ts:77`, `:165`). It saves through `POST /api/v1/batch`, while the single-record form sends a JS boolean. No door coerced the string: the single and batch doors reach the same engine normalisation, which had no boolean arm. So the column held the text `'true'` beside the form's `1`. `won = true` missed it, `requiredWhen: record.won == true` read the string and admitted an empty delivery date, and an un-ticked line (`'false'`) read back as `won: true`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.boolean-reading.test.ts` (new, 28 tests):
  - each reading on `boolean` and `toggle` is written as its boolean and admitted by the validator;
  - a readonly boolean field is normalised too, and an array of rows is normalised without mutating the input;
  - a boolean, `null` and a missing key come back as the same row;
  - each refused value (`'yes'`, `'TRUE'`, `'False'`, `' true'`, `'on'`, `2`, `-1`, `0.5`, an array, an object) comes back as the same row and is still refused as `invalid_boolean`;
  - through the engine, the driver receives booleans on insert, insertMany, update by id and update by predicate;
  - `requiredWhen` refuses `'true'`, `true`, `'1'` and `1` with no delivery date, and the driver sees no write.
- `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-34916-boolean-text-read.test.ts` (new, 9 tests, SQLite):
  - the fixture's raw storage classes are read back (SQLite's affinity keeps `'true'` / `'false'` as text and turns `'1'` / `'0'` into integers);
  - `find()` presents each cell (`'false'`, `'0'`, `'true'`, `'1'`, `1`, `0`, NULL);
  - `findOne()` presents the text `'false'` as false.
- `packages/rest/src/rest-data-boolean-reading.test.ts` (new, 6 tests): the REST door pin over SqlDriver on SQLite, through the real route handlers.
  - Single `POST`, `PATCH` and `/api/v1/batch` create and update, each with `'true'` and `'false'`, store integer `1` / `0`, the same as the form's boolean writes.
  - GET answers the boolean, and `won = true` / `won = false` each find exactly their five rows.
  - `requiredWhen` with no delivery date answers `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` for `'true'` and for `true`, at POST, PATCH, batch create and batch update. Nothing is written.
  - CONTROL: `won: 'yes'` is still `400 VALIDATION_FAILED` at POST and at the batch.
  - A legacy row whose column was written as the text `'false'` reads `won: false` at GET.

The `'0'` cell stays green because SQLite's affinity stores the text `'0'` as an integer, so no text `'0'` row exists to misread. This run came after the `objectql` restore leg, so the REST reading isolates the read fix. The restore leg rebuilt `driver-sql`, the preflight found the marker in 2 built files, the REST pin went back to 6/6, and `git status --porcelain` was empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Rows already stored as text still miss equality filters until they are saved again.** After this PR they read correctly (`won: false` for the text `'false'`), but a filter compares the stored text, so `won = false` / `won = true` do not match such a row until it is re-saved. The seat routes a backfill to triage as a follow-up: rewrite the text rows of each declared boolean column to the integer form, so that old rows become equality-filterable.
- **Follow-up routed by the seat: the inline grid's `requiredWhen` flag before save.** The grid evaluates the column's `requiredWhen` against the row it holds, and that row holds the picked option string (`ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx:797`, `resolveFieldRuleState`). So picking Yes does not flag the empty delivery date in the grid. After this PR the server refuses that save with `400 VALIDATION_FAILED`. What is left on the client is the hint before save.
- **Same class, not changed here:** driver-sql's `presentReadValue` (`sql-driver-filter-helpers.ts:333`, the `distinct()` and aggregate group-key presenter) still reads a boolean as `Boolean(value)`. So a legacy text `'false'` row would present as `true` there. It is read from the code only and was not reproduced. New writes no longer produce such rows. The backfill above removes the input it would misread.
